roles.development_responsibility: Own controlled configuration/manual, appoint qualified people, maintain authority/insurance records and prohibit dispatch on unresolved critical defects.

Control train only under accepted operating mode, acknowledge dispatch/stop communication, verify vehicle readiness and stop/no-dispatch on disagreement. Brake controls and limits must be trained on the actual accepted train.

Coordinate passenger count and accessible assistance, clear doors/platforms/stairs, maintain passenger protection and give the single defined boarding-clear confirmation. Not automatically the driver.
Protect route occupancy, crossings, station and work limits; confirm route availability and record movements. Future second-train operation requires a separate accepted separation design.

Control defect isolation, lifting/restraint/energy-specific service, configuration and restoration. Specialist wheel/axle, spring-brake, structural/NDT and electrical tasks retain their qualified personnel.

roles.role: Incident / rescue lead and trained responders
roles.development_responsibility: Coordinate protected site/evacuation/rescue decisions, emergency services access, communications and accounting. Exact rescue method/equipment and assistance training must be accepted before passenger use.

role_combination: Only if an accepted staffing/visibility/workload assessment demonstrates all functions remain covered; no default one-person operation.
training_topics: Actual controls and limitations, route/sight lines and communication
Every-vehicle service/release/readiness checks and spring parking limitations
Defect reporting, stop authority and prohibited resets/bypasses
Energy-specific maintenance, lifting/support and OEM spring-brake service for qualified personnel
Incident command, protected evacuation, emergency access and return-to-service discipline
